scope: Exactly N02–N11; ten new characters, five masculine and five feminine presentations

characters.concept: Young road-trip passenger stopping for snacks at a highway convenience store
characters.hair: short softly wavy brown hair, clear forehead
characters.clothing: pale teal lightweight winter shell open over an ivory hoodie, sand chinos, cream sneakers
characters.nevada_fit: Light layers suit a sunny, cold roadside stop without implying a profession.
characters.neutral_face: Average oval face, soft jaw, restrained brow and nose, relaxed closed mouth; no beard or eyewear.

characters.concept: Diner visitor on a winter drive between Nevada towns
characters.hair: shoulder-length dark auburn hair tucked behind both ears, face uncovered
characters.clothing: sky-blue short puffer jacket open over a warm white sweater, light denim jeans, cream ankle boots
characters.nevada_fit: Practical puffer and denim read as everyday winter travel wear.
characters.neutral_face: Moderate face width and length, rounded jaw, modest cheeks and lips, neutral expression; no facial accessories.

characters.concept: Local resident picking up coffee at a gas-station forecourt
characters.hair: short dark hair combed away from forehead
characters.clothing: light khaki canvas jacket open over a coral henley, faded blue straight jeans, tan casual boots
characters.nevada_fit: Everyday canvas outerwear works for dry, sunny winter errands without looking like a uniform.
characters.neutral_face: Ordinary proportional features, soft lower face, unobtrusive cheekbones and nose, clean-shaven.

characters.concept: Suburban-edge motel guest heading out for breakfast
characters.hair: dark hair in a low loose bun with forehead and ears visible
characters.clothing: light sage quilted vest over an ivory long-sleeve knit, beige casual trousers, light tan sneakers
characters.nevada_fit: A vest and knit layer suit cool mornings and warmer desert afternoons.
characters.neutral_face: Average soft oval structure, gentle jaw, medium lips and nose, relaxed expression; no bangs or glasses.

characters.concept: Rest-stop traveler stretching his legs after a drive
characters.hair: short salt-and-pepper hair, no forehead fringe
characters.clothing: sand fleece zip jacket open over a pale blue sweatshirt, light olive chinos, warm tan walking shoes
characters.nevada_fit: Comfortable fleece and walking shoes are believable road-trip winter layers.
characters.neutral_face: Subtle age cues with smooth average bone structure, unremarkable jaw and brow, clean-shaven neutral face.

characters.concept: Local diner customer on a bright cold morning
characters.hair: chestnut wavy hair gathered behind the neck, no face-covering strands
characters.clothing: soft coral padded jacket open over a cream crewneck, light warm-gray jeans, taupe ankle boots
characters.nevada_fit: Warm but casual clothing suits short winter trips around a small town.
characters.neutral_face: Moderate facial proportions, gently rounded jaw, soft cheeks, relaxed mouth; no glasses or earrings.

characters.concept: Parking-lot visitor outside a roadside motel
characters.hair: short neat gray hair, clear hairline and face
characters.clothing: light denim jacket open over a muted orange crewneck sweater, cream chinos, sand boots
characters.nevada_fit: Denim and a sweater are ordinary dry-weather winter clothes, not occupational attire.
characters.neutral_face: Age shown mainly through hair; face keeps average proportions, soft jaw, modest nose and cheeks, no beard.

characters.concept: Small-town shopper stopping at a convenience store
characters.hair: short chestnut bob tucked behind the ears, forehead visible
characters.clothing: pale blue casual winter coat open over an ivory sweatshirt, light beige pants, tan low boots
characters.nevada_fit: Simple coat and sweatshirt fit everyday local errands in winter.
characters.neutral_face: Soft middle-aged face with ordinary width, light cheek definition, rounded jaw, neutral mouth and brows.

characters.concept: Driver taking a quick break at a highway service area
characters.hair: close-cropped black hair with an unobstructed forehead
characters.clothing: soft red quilted vest over a cream hoodie, washed light-blue jeans, off-white sneakers
characters.nevada_fit: A vest and hoodie give flexible warmth for a sunny roadside stop.
characters.neutral_face: Balanced average face, gently rounded chin, moderate features, clean-shaven and relaxed.

characters.concept: Young traveler walking back to a parked car after a diner stop
characters.hair: medium curly hair tied in a low ponytail, curls kept behind the face
characters.clothing: sand zip jacket open over a pale teal sweatshirt, ivory casual pants, light beige sneakers
characters.nevada_fit: Casual layers and sneakers suit mild desert sun with winter chill.
characters.neutral_face: Unaccented average face shape, softly rounded jaw, modest brow and lips, neutral expression without accessories.
